_comment: Workbook exercise plant-sensor-vs-equipment (docs/workbook/plant-sensor-vs-equipment.md): the physical plant rules run over the lbnl-chiller sensor-bias runs, to see where a lying sensor shows up. chiller_efficiency (1.44 kW/ton) and cooling_tower_approach (8.1 F) keep the dataset template's ceilings, calibrated from the fault-free run, so `camber datasets score` scores the two declared detectors exactly as the template does. condenser_bypass_leak (defaults) separates a leaking tower bypass from an offset between the tower leaving-water and condenser entering-water sensors. chw_pump_dp_reset (fixed bands) reads the secondary pump speed, which is where a biased loop DP sensor shows.
